user.title: Swiss Avalanche Bulletin (SLF)
user.description: Sets up the Swiss avalanche bulletin (SLF) for a location. Latitude/longitude default to your Home Assistant home location, but can be changed to any location in/near Switzerland. Add the integration again to track another location.

imis.title: IMIS measuring stations (optional)
imis.description: Optionally add favourite IMIS measuring stations of the SLF: snow depth, new snow, temperatures and wind, updated every 30 minutes. Any station can be selected — the list is sorted by distance from this location (❄ snow station, 🌬 wind station), type to search. Favourites can be changed later via the integration options. Leave empty to skip.

error.cannot_connect: Could not determine the SLF warning region for these coordinates.

init.title: IMIS measuring stations
init.description: Manage the favourite IMIS measuring stations of this location. The list is sorted by distance (❄ snow station, 🌬 wind station), type to search.
